title: Gold Rewards Card: Concierge Support Services - What's Included
summary: This document explains what’s included with the Gold Rewards Card concierge support: 24/7 access with new requests acknowledged within 2 hours. It covers travel, dining/entertainment, personal logistics, trip disruption support, and tailored vetted recommendations, with third-party costs on the customer and no purchases finalized without explicit approval and payment authorization.
